name: FFS_QTS_QUOTA_CTGR
description: Contains quota defined on the capacity category level.

columns.name: ARCH_DATE
columns.description: DB record partitioning date. Set automatically by DB Optimization job.

columns.name: PAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to PAGE_ID in FFS_QTS_QUOTA_PAGE.

columns.name: TIME_SLOT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to TIME_SLOT_ID in FFS_TIME_SLOT.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to WORK_SKILL_ID in FFS_WORK_SKILL.

columns.name: QUOTA_PERCENT
columns.description: Value of quota percent either from max available or TS level.

columns.name: MIN_QUOTA
columns.description: Minimum number of minutes to be allocated for booking of activities that belong to this category.

columns.name: QUOTA
columns.description: Absolute value of quota in minutes.

columns.name: STOP_BOOKING_AT
columns.description: Percent used quota on parent level when booking should be stopped for this category.

columns.name: CLOSED_AT
columns.description: Time when this quota cell was closed. Capacity area time zone is used.

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: Bitmask that defines status of quota record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
